comment.text: CBFB M1 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Breast tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting CBFB residue M1 have been observed in breast tumors.
